title: Polynomial evaluation locally spans the associated graded extended ideal algebra
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $r\in\mathbf N$, and $x:\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to A$ a family with $I=(x_0,\ldots,x_{r-1})$. Let $X$ be a scheme and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ a morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] and $B_k=J^k/J^{k+1}$, including $B_0=\mathcal O_X/J$, with quotient maps $\pi_k:J^k\to B_k$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces]. Suppose $G$ is a commutative unital graded sheaf algebra structure on $B$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], whose unit is $\pi_0$ and whose multiplication is multiplication on representatives: for local $a\in J^k(U)$, $b\in J^l(U)$, there is $c\in J^{k+l}(U)$ mapping to the product of their images in $\mathcal O_X(U)$, with $G_{k,l}(\pi_k(a),\pi_l(b))=\pi_{k+l}(c)$. Put $P=A[T_0,\ldots,T_{r-1}]$ and let $P_k$ be its homogeneous degree-$k$ submodule. There exist maps $e_{k,U}:P_k\to B_k(U)$ for all $k$ and opens $U$, commuting with restriction and addition, such that $G_{k,l}(e_{k,U}(b),e_{l,U}(b'))=e_{k+l,U}(bb')$, and $e_{0,U}(C(a))=G.\mathrm{unit}_U(f^\sharp(a)|_U)$. Furthermore, for every $k$, open $U$, finite family $a_i\in B_k(U)$ and $y\in U$, there is $y\in W\subseteq U$ such that each $a_i|_W$ lies in the $\mathcal O_X(W)$-span of $\{e_{k,W}(b):b\in P_k\}$. Empty generating families and empty section families are allowed. No Noetherian hypothesis or formal module is assumed.

proof.text: On an affine open V, the closed declaration Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_appLE identifies J(V) with the ideal generated by the images of the given x_i. For a homogeneous polynomial b of degree k evaluate it in O_X(V), using f-sharp for coefficients. Its value belongs to J(V)^k. For k>0 the affine power-range formula uniquely lifts this value to the module realization of J^k; for k=0 the inclusion is the identity. The inclusions are monic by induction on the recursive ideal-power definition (image inclusions are monic).

On nested affine opens naturality of the power inclusion and its injectivity identify the restrictions of these lifts. On intersections compare on an affine cover; sheaf separation then identifies them. The sheaf condition glues the compatible affine lifts to every open U. Project by pi_k to define e(k,U,b). The construction is natural in U.

Additivity of polynomial evaluation and linearity and injectivity of the power inclusions imply additivity of the lifts, hence of e. Apply the stipulated representative multiplication to the lifts of b and b-prime; its section c and the lift of bb-prime have the same structure-sheaf image, so are equal. Projection gives the multiplication identity. In degree zero the lift of C(a) is f-sharp(a), and the stipulated unit pi_0 gives the constant formula.

Choose an affine neighbourhood W of y contained in U. The power modules are quasi-coherent. Apply the affine quotient-surjectivity assertion to J^k to lift all restricted a_i to sections of J^k on W (degree zero uses the quasi-coherent structure module). Their images belong to J(W)^k by the affine power-range assertion.

The identity Ideal.span_pow_eq_map_homogeneousSubmodule (Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPolynomial/Homogeneous.lean:661) writes an element of the kth power of the ideal generated by the images of x_i as evaluation of a homogeneous polynomial with coefficients in O_X(W). Expand that polynomial into its finite monomial sum: each monomial with coefficient one is defined over A, so the value is in the O_X(W)-span of evaluations of polynomials in P_k. Injectivity of the power inclusion gives the same formula for each lift, and applying pi_k gives the required span membership. For k=0, the unit spans the quotient. This uses one Mathlib identity followed by linearity; it asserts no extra sheaf lifting.

theorem formalAssociatedGraded_polynomial_cover
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    {r : ℕ} (generators : Fin r → A) (hgenerators : Ideal.span (Set.range generators) = I)
    (G : GradedSheafAlgebra (formalAssociatedGradedPiece
      ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)))
    (hunit : G.unit = formalAssociatedGradedπ _ 0)
    (hmul : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
      (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower
        ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
          (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f).toModulesι m).1.val.obj
          (op U))
      (b : (Scheme.idealSheafPower
        ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
          (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f).toModulesι n).1.val.obj
          (op U)),
      ∃ c : (Scheme.idealSheafPower
        ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
          (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f).toModulesι
          (m + n)).1.val.obj (op U),
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower _ (m + n)).2.val.app (op U) c =
          (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower _ m).2.val.app (op U) a)) *
            (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower _ n).2.val.app (op U) b)) ∧
        G.mul m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ _ m).val.app (op U) a)
          ((formalAssociatedGradedπ _ n).val.app (op U) b) =
            (formalAssociatedGradedπ _ (m + n)).val.app (op U) c) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (k : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A k →
        (formalAssociatedGradedPiece
          ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
            (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) k).val.obj (op U),
      (∀ k U V (h : V ≤ U) b,
        (formalAssociatedGradedPiece _ k).val.map (homOfLE h).op (e k U b) = e k V b) ∧
      (∀ k U b b', e k U (b + b') = e k U b + e k U b') ∧
      (∀ k l U b b', G.mul k l U (e k U b) (e l U b') =
        e (k + l) U ⟨b.val * b'.val, b.property.mul b'.property⟩) ∧
      (∀ U a, e 0 U ⟨MvPolynomial.C a, MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (Fin r) a⟩ =
        G.unit.val.app (op U)
          ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom
            (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a))) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (s : ℕ)
        (a : Fin s → (formalAssociatedGradedPiece _ k).val.obj (op U))
        (y : X), y ∈ U → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), y ∈ W ∧
          ∀ i, (formalAssociatedGradedPiece _ k).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (a i) ∈
            Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (e k W)))
